scenario.name: Blackwell wafer, HBM, and package conversion
scenario.notes: Product topology uses primary NVIDIA and Micron documents. All process and capacity inputs remain synthetic.

evidence.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Platform Arrives to Power a New Era of Computing
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports a custom TSMC 4NP process and two reticle-limit GPU dies per Blackwell GPU.

evidence.title: NVIDIA Transformer Engine CPU offloading documentation
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA documents 192 GB HBM3E per GB200 Blackwell GPU.

evidence.title: Micron HBM3E product specifications
evidence.excerpt: Micron reports 24 GB capacity for an 8-high HBM3E placement and 36 GB for a 12-high placement.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 product specifications
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports 72 Blackwell GPUs in one GB200 NVL72 rack-scale system.

evidence.title: TSMC second-quarter 2026 management report
evidence.excerpt: TSMC reports 4.336 million 12-inch-equivalent wafer shipments across the company in 2Q26.

evidence.title: Illustrative wafer, yield, binning, and assembly assumptions
evidence.excerpt: Wafer starts, die geometry, defect density, yield, bin share, supplier allocation, and assembly throughput are synthetic.

references.name: TSMC total 12-inch-equivalent wafer shipments

estimate.methodology: Uses TSMC's reported 2Q26 company-wide 12-inch-equivalent wafer shipments as a prior-quarter scale control. It does not isolate 4NP, NVIDIA, or Blackwell.
estimate.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
estimate.falsifying_evidence: TSMC revises the reported 2Q26 shipment total or changes its unit basis.

references.notes: This prior-quarter company total checks scale only. It cannot allocate wafers by node, customer, or product and does not replace synthetic Blackwell wafer starts.

wafer.name: Illustrative Blackwell logic wafer flow

wafer_starts.methodology: Illustrative quarterly Blackwell logic wafer starts. NVIDIA and TSMC do not disclose this range in the cited documents.
wafer_starts.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
wafer_starts.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer_diameter_mm.methodology: Reference 300 mm logic wafer diameter; the cited product documents do not state wafer diameter.
wafer_diameter_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
wafer_diameter_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

edge_exclusion_mm.methodology: Illustrative unusable wafer edge used by the gross-die approximation.
edge_exclusion_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
edge_exclusion_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

die_width_mm.methodology: Illustrative reticle-scale die width. NVIDIA discloses a reticle-limit design but not dimensions.
die_width_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
die_width_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

die_height_mm.methodology: Illustrative reticle-scale die height. NVIDIA discloses a reticle-limit design but not dimensions.
die_height_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
die_height_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

scribe_width_mm.methodology: Illustrative scribe width added to both die dimensions.
scribe_width_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
scribe_width_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer.notes: The gross-die result is a geometry sensitivity, not a disclosed Blackwell dies-per-wafer value.

defect_density_per_cm2.methodology: Illustrative random-defect density for the negative-binomial yield model.
defect_density_per_cm2.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
defect_density_per_cm2.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

clustering_alpha.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
clustering_alpha.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer_sort_yield.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
wafer_sort_yield.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

performance_bin_share.methodology: Illustrative share of known-good logic dies that meet the modeled accelerator bin.
performance_bin_share.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
performance_bin_share.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer.name: Illustrative HBM3E memory-die wafer flow

wafer_starts.methodology: Illustrative combined HBM3E memory wafer starts before supplier and product allocation.
wafer_starts.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
wafer_starts.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer_diameter_mm.methodology: Reference 300 mm DRAM wafer diameter; the cited product page does not disclose fab geometry.
wafer_diameter_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
wafer_diameter_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

edge_exclusion_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
edge_exclusion_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

die_width_mm.methodology: Illustrative HBM3E memory-die width; no supplier die dimension is asserted.
die_width_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
die_width_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

die_height_mm.methodology: Illustrative HBM3E memory-die height; no supplier die dimension is asserted.
die_height_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
die_height_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

scribe_width_mm.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
scribe_width_mm.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

wafer.notes: Supplier mix, node, die size, wafer allocation, and redundancy repair remain unmodeled evidence gaps.

known_good_die_yield.methodology: Illustrative HBM known-good memory-die yield after repair and test.
known_good_die_yield.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
known_good_die_yield.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

memory_dies_per_stack.methodology: Uses Micron's disclosed 24 GB 8-high HBM3E product as a reference stack. It does not assert Micron supply to GB200.
memory_dies_per_stack.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
memory_dies_per_stack.falsifying_evidence: A GB200 manufacturing BOM uses a different HBM layer count or capacity per placement.

stack_assembly_yield.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
stack_assembly_yield.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

stack_final_test_yield.methodology: Illustrative final HBM stack test yield.
stack_final_test_yield.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
stack_final_test_yield.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

stack_capacity_gb.methodology: Uses Micron's disclosed 24 GB 8-high HBM3E product as a reference placement.
stack_capacity_gb.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
stack_capacity_gb.falsifying_evidence: The selected GB200 configuration uses a different capacity per HBM placement.

stacks_per_accelerator.methodology: Divides NVIDIA's 192 GB per GB200 GPU by the 24 GB reference HBM3E placement. This derives eight placements and does not identify the memory supplier.
stacks_per_accelerator.confirming_evidence: A current product BOM reports the same physical topology.
stacks_per_accelerator.falsifying_evidence: A product BOM reports a different placement count or stack capacity.

assembly_starts.methodology: Illustrative quarterly advanced-package assembly starts allocated to the modeled accelerator.
assembly_starts.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
assembly_starts.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

assembly_yield.methodology: Illustrative final advanced-package assembly and test yield.
assembly_yield.confirming_evidence: Supplier wafer starts, process-control, yield, binning, or assembly records support the range.
assembly_yield.falsifying_evidence: Verified production or process data place the input outside the range.

logic_dies_per_accelerator.methodology: Uses NVIDIA's disclosure of two reticle-limit GPU dies in one Blackwell GPU.
logic_dies_per_accelerator.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
logic_dies_per_accelerator.falsifying_evidence: A product teardown or manufacturing BOM reports a different logic-die count.

accelerators_per_system.methodology: Uses NVIDIA's disclosure of 72 Blackwell GPUs per GB200 NVL72.
accelerators_per_system.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
accelerators_per_system.falsifying_evidence: A current NVIDIA rack BOM reports a different GPU count.
